meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以主持一个“站会”，让多个 Git 工作树或分支的“代理”在共享文件中对话，比较各自的变更，最终产出一个合并计划。Claude 负责召集、引导对话并总结结果。
howto.when: 当用户有多个 Git 工作树或分支需要合并，或想对比不同分支的变更时，可以要求 Claude 发起站会。

say.text: 帮我开个站会，把最近4小时活跃的工作树合并成一个。
say.note: Claude 会列出活跃工作树，确认后开始对话。

say.text: 站会，对比 main 和 feature-x 分支，给出合并方案。
say.note: Claude 会手动指定分支，然后运行站会流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can facilitate a 'standup' where agents representing multiple git worktrees or branches converse in a shared file, compare changes, and produce a consolidation plan. Claude convenes, guides rounds, and writes the summary.
howto.when_en: When the user has multiple git worktrees or branches to consolidate, or wants to compare changes across branches, they can ask Claude to start a standup.

say_en.text: Run a standup for worktrees active in the last 4 hours and merge them into one.
say_en.note: Claude lists active worktrees, confirms, then starts the conversation.

say_en.text: Standup: compare main and feature-x branches and give a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude manually specifies branches, then runs the standup process.
